description: Add the `page` and `pagelen` query members to every list operation whose 200 response is Bitbucket's collection envelope (`{ values, next, page?, pagelen?, size? }`) and whose spec parameters leave them out. The API documents both for every collection (https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#pagination): `pagelen` sets the page size (10 by default, at most 100), and the `next` URL carries the next page as its `page` query value, a number (`?page=3`) or, on iterator collections such as commits, an opaque cursor. The spec declares them on only a few operations (getPullrequestsForCommit, getPipelinesForRepository). `page` is a string so an opaque cursor fits.
